summary: @or-sdk/markdowner preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs detects the installer's platform/arch, downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun v1.3.13 GitHub release zip, extracts and chmod+x's `bun`/`bun.exe` to a temp directory, then execFileSync's it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727 KB obfuscated JavaScript bundle (Bun-CJS header, string-array rotation via `WV8StW` cycling constant array `n7gIxM`, per-string decoder `hc1jfK9`, hex-mangled globals) whose network destinations are reconstructed at runtime from fragments rather than appearing as plain literals. The package presents itself as a markdown SDK but its `package.json` has empty `description`, empty `author`, and no `repository` field, and none of the declared purpose requires an alternate runtime or a multi-hundred-KB obfuscated init bundle. The result is that `npm install @or-sdk/markdowner` fetches a second interpreter for the sole purpose of running opaque, obfuscated code on the installer's host, bypassing any inspection of the JavaScript by Node's normal loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
